purpose: Diagnose the two historical Landsat-7 source identifiers that failed the frozen Collection-2 crosswalk, without changing the 95% crosswalk gate.

diagnostic.point_selection: deterministic evenly spaced rows after sorting by latitude then longitude
diagnostic.query: exact acquisition date at each published pixel coordinate
diagnostic.report: all Landsat-7 candidate item IDs and WRS path/row values returned at sampled points

rules: Do not alter the frozen crosswalk pass thresholds.
Do not relabel a source file as another WRS row unless the published pixel coordinates consistently intersect that alternate Collection-2 item.
Do not use published d-value magnitude or any penguin demographic outcome in the identity diagnosis.
